title: Casebound narrative claims
description: The output a narrative model returns: a list of claims, each citing canonical event ids and asserting the facts it states. The verifier accepts a claim only when one cited event matches every non-null asserted field. See docs/verification.md. This form is strict (every property required, nullable where optional) so it can constrain a model's structured output directly.

text.description: A readable sentence for the audit trail. Never shown as a fact: the report phrases accepted claims from the cited event's own fields.

citations.description: The event_id values (64 lowercase hex characters) the claim rests on.

asserts.description: The facts the claim states, copied exactly from the cited event. Null means the claim does not assert that field.

revises.description: On a revision round, the claim_id of the rejected claim this one replaces; null otherwise.
